content: {"episode_id":"ep-05007","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05007, denied because prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes, supporting the medical necessity of CPT 93229."}
